get.description:
Returns doctors awaiting admin approval, oldest application first. All of them by default;
pass PageSize (1–100) and PageNumber for one page. The total is in the X-Total-Count header.

post.description:
Approves a pending doctor. Doctor becomes visible in search
and can set their schedule after approval.

Suspends a doctor account. Sets IsActive = false on ApplicationUser.
Doctor cannot login after suspension.

get.description: Admin view — includes inactive specialties.

post.description: Creates a new specialty. Name must be unique.

put.description: Updates name, description, or icon of an existing specialty.

delete.description: Hard deletes only if no doctors are currently assigned.

get.description:
Returns total counts for doctors, patients, appointments,
specialties, pending approvals, and reviews.
Returns appointment count broken down by status.

post.description:
Patient books an available slot. Slot must be Available and in the future.
Atomic check prevents race conditions — two patients cannot book the same slot.

get.description:
Returns the authenticated patient's appointments.
Filter by Status. Paginated via PageNumber and PageSize.

Returns the authenticated doctor's appointments.
Filter by Status. Paginated via PageNumber and PageSize.
Returns full appointment details. Only the owning patient, the owning doctor or an admin can access.

post.description:
Patient: can only cancel their own appointment, more than 2 hours before start time.
Doctor: can cancel any of their own appointments with no time restriction.
Admin: can cancel any appointment with no restriction.
Slot is freed back to Available after cancellation.

Doctor marks the appointment as completed after the visit.
Only the doctor who owns the appointment can complete it.
Patient can leave a review once the appointment is completed.

post.summary: Mark an appointment as a no-show
post.description:
The owning doctor or an admin marks a Confirmed appointment as missed, at least 15 minutes
after it was due to start. Cancelled, completed and already-marked appointments return 409.

put.description:
Doctor adds clinical notes to an appointment.
Can only be added to Confirmed or Completed appointments — not Cancelled or Pending.
Only the owning doctor can add notes.

post.description: Creates a patient account. Email confirmation required before login.
Creates a doctor account. Requires admin approval before appearing in search.
Returns JWT access token and refresh token. Email must be confirmed first.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token + refresh token pair.

Revokes the refresh token. Works without an access token, so a user whose access token has expired
can still log out; with a valid access token, the refresh token must belong to the caller.
Validates the email confirmation token sent after registration.

Sends a password reset email. Always returns 204 regardless of whether
the email exists — prevents email enumeration.
Resets the password using the token from the reset email. Revokes all active sessions.

get.description:
Returns paginated, approved doctors only.
Filter by SpecialtyId, City. Sort by Rating, Fee, or Experience.
Returns full doctor profile including specialty and rating. 404 if not approved or not found.
Returns Available slots for a doctor on a specific date. `date` is required (400 without it).
Returns visible reviews for a doctor.

put.description:
Updates the authenticated doctor's own profile.
Updatable fields: Bio, ConsultationFee, ClinicAddress, ClinicCity.
Specialty and approval status cannot be changed through this endpoint.

get.description: Get the doctor's own schedules

post.description:
Creates a weekly recurring schedule for one day. Generates appointment slots
for the next 14 days immediately. One schedule per day of week — duplicate
days are rejected.

put.description:
Updates an existing schedule's hours, slot duration, or active status.
Future free slots are deleted and regenerated with the new times, in one transaction.
Booked slots, and slots a cancelled appointment points to, are kept; new slots skip times that overlap them.

delete.description:
Removes the schedule and its free slots. Returns 409 while upcoming appointments are booked on it.
A schedule whose slots have past appointments is deactivated instead, to keep that history.

get.description:
Returns the authenticated user's notifications ordered by most recent first, one page at a time
(PageNumber, PageSize: default 1 and 50, at most 100). The total is in the X-Total-Count header.
Pass unreadOnly=true to get only unread notifications.

post.description:
Marks a single notification as read.
Only the owner of the notification can mark it as read.
Marks all of the authenticated user's unread notifications as read.

get.description: Returns the authenticated patient's own profile, including medical info.

patch.description:
Partially updates the authenticated patient's profile.
Only provided fields are changed — omitted fields remain unchanged.

get.description:
Returns the authenticated user's profile.
Works for all roles — Patient, Doctor, Admin.
For role-specific medical or professional info use the
patient or doctor profile endpoints.

patch.description:
Partially updates the authenticated user's profile.
Only provided fields are changed — omitted fields remain unchanged.
To change email use the auth endpoints.

post.description:
Patient submits a review for a completed appointment.
Rating must be between 1 and 5.
One review per appointment — duplicates are rejected.
Doctor's average rating is recomputed after submission.

get.description:
Returns paginated visible reviews for a doctor.
Ordered by most recent first.

delete.description:
Patient can delete their own review.
Admin can delete any review.
Doctor's average rating is recomputed after deletion.

get.description: Returns all active specialties. Admin can see inactive ones by passing includeInactive=true.

post.description: Admin only. Creates a new specialty. Name must be unique.

get.description: Returns a single active specialty by its ID.

put.description: Admin only. Updates name, description, or icon of an existing specialty.

delete.description: Admin only. Hard deletes a specialty only if no doctors are assigned to it.

get.summary: Get the organization's plan, modules and limits
get.description: The organization's plan code, subscription status and period, every enabled module (core modules, the plan's add-ons and overrides, closed over dependencies), the add-on overrides, and each limit with its usage (included is null when the plan sets no such limit). Requires org.settings.manage.
The codes of every enabled module, core included, in catalog order. Public: patients' and visitors' pages follow the plan too.
The plans on the platform's price list, each with the add-ons it includes (core modules come with every plan) and its limits (null when the plan sets none). Requires org.settings.manage.

put.description: Moves the organization to the plan with this code (Starter, Clinic, Full). Overrides the new plan makes redundant are dropped. The new modules apply to the next request. 403 Subscription.SwitchingDisabled unless the deployment allows plan switching. Requires org.settings.manage.

put.summary: Switch an add-on on or off
put.description: Switches an add-on module on beyond the plan, or off within it; back to what the plan says removes the override. Switching on also enables what the add-on needs. 409 Subscription.ModuleRequired while an enabled add-on needs the module; 403 Subscription.SwitchingDisabled unless the deployment allows plan switching. Requires org.settings.manage.
